inputs: FilelistAddData, bundle name, local target, priority, ErrorMethod or request ID.
effects: Adds one pending request per user/list path; duplicate same path returns existing record. Emits Added, then queues list or handles open list. ADC requests partial recursive list; NMDC serializes to one pending list. Validates requested directory exists and is complete, creates queue bundle, sets QUEUED/result/error/processed tick and emits Processed. Missing/incomplete after a fetched list fails to avoid infinite retry. Pending task cancellation removes queue item and awaits callback; completed/failed task cancellation removes immediately. Processed/failed records expire after 120 seconds.
errors: Queue errors set FAILED and rethrow; duplicate list queue is swallowed; directory missing/incomplete yields fixed error. Logging only when ErrorMethod::LOG.
behavior.completion: Async; state PENDING→QUEUED or FAILED; record expiry 120s after processed tick.
behavior.cancellation: Unknown ID returns false; pending removal is callback-driven; processed/failed removal immediate.
resources: DirectoryListing cache, QueueManager list/bundle operations, timer.

acceptance_scenarios: Given same-user same-path task is pending, when a duplicate add arrives, then existing ID is returned without a second Added event.
